messages:
alex: Heads-up — thinking through a 'snapshot compare' flow in Console for route/model analytics. Want to capture telemetry + routing hints so teams can diff perf/cost between two points-in-time.

maria: +1 needed. what's the minimal API shape? we don't want a huge payload for saved queries.

alex: Proposal: POST /api/v1/console/snapshots
payload: { "route": "string", "model": "string", "time_range": {"start":"iso","end":"iso"}, "sampling": 0.01, "include_routing_hints": true }

chris_k: can we keep sampling defaulted to 'weighted by token-burn' instead of uniform? otherwise edges get noisy.

alex: Good point. Suggest sampling: "strategy": "traffic_weighted" | "uniform", "rate": number. default traffic_weighted @ 0.005

jamal: Telemetry concern: we need to record sampling metadata in the snapshot so console can reproduce a compare exactly. Also store model-variant pinned.

maria: Also need quota check on snapshot creation — these can be expensive. Should be gated by project quota or require a compute lock.

product-lead: We should add a soft-cost-preview in the UI before snapshoting, show estimated token burn and expected latency SLO risk. ux + permissions.

alex: API response includes cost_estimate and estimated_sampled_points. Example:
```
{ "snapshot_id":"s_123", "cost_estimate":"$1.42", "sampled_points":1200 }
```

chris_k: On storage: snapshots should be TTL'd by default (30 days), with an opt-in to persist longer for audits. and versioned so compare snapshots are immutable.

jamal: Regarding routing hints: if include_routing_hints=true we must capture policy_id and fallback_chain, plus model quantization profile used at time.

maria: For rollout UX: can we surface if a snapshot was created during a canary? if so mark as 'canary-context' so PMs know sample bias.

console-bot: snapshot s_123 created by alex at 2024-06-04T14:12:10Z (sampling: traffic_weighted@0.005) :white_check_mark:

product-lead: timeline — need an API PR by EOD Thurs, console mockups by next Tue. canary rollout to 10% orgs initially. @maria please own the mockups :raised_hands:

maria: on it. also will add a compact 'compare diff' that highlights delta by median latency, p95, and token burn delta.

alex: TL;DR: agree on API shape, add sampling metadata and cost preview, quota gating, snapshot TTL + persist opt-in, mark canary context. I'll open an RFC PR with the example payloads.

chris_k: nit: include schema_version on snapshot so future changes don't break compares.

jamal: +1 schema_version and also a small checksum of included telemetry set.

maria: thanks team — I'll sync with design and post mockups in #product-design later today. 

alex: thanks everyone :rocket:
